source_only_case_rationales.C735_invalid__private: C735 forbids the repeated PRIVATE header attribute. The complete module type and one-attribute deletion repair are valid otherwise. A current exact Flang warning exists only in f2018; GNU silence is not corroboration.
source_only_case_rationales.C735_invalid__public: The same exact repeated-header-attribute constraint applies independently to PUBLIC. Module scope and component declaration are valid, and deleting one PUBLIC is the sole repair. Older-mode warning evidence is retained without f2023 credit.
source_only_case_rationales.C737_invalid__nontype_parent: selector is an already defined integer PARAMETER, not a derived type. EXTENDS requires a prior extensible type; switching only to good_parent repairs it. A GNU claim that selector is not previously defined is the wrong property, not a qualifying report.
source_only_case_rationales.C740_invalid__child_sequence: The ordinary parent is already extensible. The child's simultaneous EXTENDS and SEQUENCE violates C740; removing SEQUENCE repairs it. A consequence about an implicit parent component not being SEQUENCE is not the selected cause.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_invalid__event: The child adds EVENT_TYPE while the parent has no EVENT/LOCK/NOTIFY potential component and is none of those types. The parent's explicit integer coarray independently satisfies C741. Adding only an EVENT_TYPE seed repairs the type-level premise; no named opaque object is formed.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_invalid__lock: The corresponding LOCK_TYPE introduction lacks every permitted special-parent alternative. C741 is already satisfied. The one-seed repair is type-only and does not operate on a lock value.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_invalid__notify: The original f2023 C742 explicitly includes NOTIFY_TYPE. The parent is not special and has no special potential component; adding a NOTIFY_TYPE seed repairs that condition. Missing intrinsic-module support and an older EVENT/LOCK-only diagnostic cannot substitute.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__event_repair: The parent's EVENT_TYPE seed supplies a permitted C742 parent; the explicit parent coarray satisfies C741. The complete input defines types only. Restrictions on hypothetical named variables do not prohibit this otherwise conforming unused definition unit.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__event_to_lock: An EVENT_TYPE parent component is an allowed alternative when the child adds LOCK_TYPE: C742 does not require matching categories. The module contains no named opaque variables or operations, and both coarray-presence premises are satisfied.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__lock_repair: The added parent LOCK_TYPE seed supplies the missing qualifying parent property. Other declarations are unchanged and type-only; GNU's hypothetical variable-codimension reasoning is not source invalidity.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__lock_to_notify: A LOCK_TYPE parent component qualifies a child NOTIFY_TYPE component under the original three-category disjunction. NOTIFY is required by the pinned f2023 source. No opaque value is constructed or inspected.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__notify_parent: Original 16.10.2.22 makes NOTIFY_TYPE extensible and C742 expressly admits it as the parent itself. The child adds only an ordinary integer component, with no named object; private implementation details are irrelevant.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__notify_repair: The parent's NOTIFY_TYPE seed supplies the same-type alternative explicitly permitted by C742, while the integer coarray independently preserves C741. This is type-only admission, not a claim that every object of that combination can be instantiated.
source_only_case_rationales.C742_valid__notify_to_event: The parent's NOTIFY_TYPE potential component satisfies C742 for an EVENT_TYPE addition. The actual Flang EVENT/LOCK-only condition omits this required alternative; it is not a valid oracle for the source. No private representation is inferred.
source_only_case_rationales.C743_invalid__private: The same component PRIVATE statement appears twice before a valid integer component. C743 forbids that repeated alternative; deleting only its second occurrence repairs it. It is not a header or binding PRIVATE duplication.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_invalid__empty: An empty ordinary type is allowed, but the actual SEQUENCE type has no component and violates C745. Adding one integer component is the sole repair. Flang's exact warning is an older-mode observation, not f2023 validation.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_invalid__enum_component: The retained named ENUM,BIND(C) declaration is valid f2023. Its named enum type is nonintrinsic and not a derived SEQUENCE type, so the actual SEQUENCE record component violates C745. Replacing only TYPE(category) with INTEGER repairs the component; unsupported named-enum parsing is a different failure.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_valid__enum_component_repair: The valid named f2023 enum definition remains, and the record's sole component is now INTEGER. SEQUENCE is nonempty, nonparameterized and has no binding part. The references' missing named-enum implementation does not make this control invalid.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_invalid__enumeration_component: The original enumeration type is explicitly nonintrinsic and not derived. A SEQUENCE data component of that type is therefore excluded by C745. The only repair changes the component to INTEGER; the legitimate enumeration definition remains.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_valid__enumeration_component_repair: The repaired SEQUENCE record contains ordinary INTEGER and satisfies C745. The separate enumeration definition has a valid enumerator and ending. Parser failures on that required f2023 facility are not a reason to delete it or weaken the control.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_invalid__kind_parameter: The KIND parameter is correctly declared before SEQUENCE and before the component. C745 nevertheless excludes any type parameter on a SEQUENCE type. Removing only SEQUENCE repairs it; a complaint about ordering is the wrong cause.
source_only_case_rationales.C745_invalid__length_parameter: The analogous LEN declaration is correctly ordered and defaulted. The sole intended exclusion is a parameterized SEQUENCE type, not a false component-order or constancy condition.
source_only_case_rationales.R726_invalid__late_parameter: The declared header parameter is defined after the first component, violating the actual R726 order. Swapping only those adjacent statements yields a valid complete PDT; no unsupported intrinsic kind value is involved.
source_only_case_rationales.R728_invalid__bind_name: R728 admits BIND(C) on a type but no NAME= label. Removing only the label preserves a valid nonempty BIND type with mandatory C_INT. The narrow type-label contract is prospective; generic mangled-definition or parser recovery is not claimed as its observation.
source_only_case_rationales.R728_invalid__parameterized_parent: EXTENDS takes a parent type name, not a derived-type specifier with actual values. The parent is already a valid defaulted PDT. Removing only its actual list yields legal inherited parameters; broad parenthesis recovery does not corroborate this cause.
source_only_case_rationales.R732_invalid__parameter_colons: The actual parameter-definition statement has a single colon instead of the required double colon. Header membership and all other declarations are valid. Replacing the colon is the exact repair; the target's specific token report is not a reference receipt.
source_only_case_rationales.R732_invalid__parameter_comma: The comma between INTEGER and KIND is absent in the defining statement. Its insertion alone repairs R732 with unchanged header/name context. The source/adjacent-token relation is independently valid; generic reference declaration/name recovery is not counted.
source_only_case_rationales.S7_5_2_4_001_valid__parameters: Both initialized objects refer to one ordinary extensible PDT definition. Original SAME_TYPE_AS ignores KIND parameters, so differing abstract KIND/LEN values still require true. No mismatching-parameter assignment is attempted. GNU's actual ERROR STOP 3 and Flang lowering failure are implementation observations, not a missing source oracle.
source_only_case_rationales.S7_5_3_1_002_valid__kind_default_to_sele: p4 converts the default -2 to the declared INTEGER(SELECTED_INT_KIND(18)) carrier. The value fits independently, and the explicit selected-kind dummy is therefore correct. GNU's INTEGER(4)-to-INTEGER(8) complaint reflects retaining the initializer kind, not a source-invalid call. Flang succeeds only in f2018.
source_only_case_rationales.S7_5_3_1_002_valid__kind_selected_to_def: The selected-kind -2_ik default is converted to the parameter's declared default INTEGER kind. Both value ranges suffice. The explicit default-integer dummy is correct; GNU's inverse 8-to-4 complaint must not be accommodated by changing the oracle.
source_only_case_rationales.S7_5_3_1_004_valid__dependent_default: The previously declared KIND tag is a permitted constant primary in the later LEN default. Explicit tag default 2 yields extent 3; supplied tag 5 yields extent 6. Ordinary payloads are initialized before observation. Both reference crashes remain failures, with no justification for lowering phase or weakening the expected values.
